title: Seat-role fall-through at the advisor door plus doctor hat-description advisory
action: Add SEAT_ROLES (8 names: lane-1..lane-3, hat-facts-gaps, hat-risks, hat-value, hat-alternatives, hat-user-impact) beside tier_role_list in models.rs with an eq_ignore_ascii_case membership helper (per D1, P2-2). In prepare.rs canonical-role arm: when kind==advisor and the declared role is a seat whose slot resolves nothing (absent, null, or resolve_configured None — P1-2), rebind canonical_role to advisor so the existing advisor arm runs (one-name walk, advisor_not_configured refusal preserved, per D2/4faf1de9); record requested_role (the asked-for seat) on the payload and dispatch-log row (P3-3). Never read description at the door (display-only law). In doctor.rs: advisory finding listing every configured hat-* slot lacking a description, reading RAW config via the role_slot_description pattern (per D3 venue decision). Unit tests in verbs::drivers per the plan test matrix incl. null-slot, mixed-case, string-shaped-hat, gather-kind-refusal, advisor_not_configured rows.

truths: --kind advisor --role lane-3 with lane-3 absent OR null resolves the advisor slot and stamps marker advisor
--kind gather --role lane-3 unconfigured still refuses role_not_configured
configured seat resolves its own model and marker names the seat

artifacts.substantive: SEAT_ROLES constant with case-folded membership, no TODO stubs

key_links: prepare.rs canonical-role arm consults SEAT_ROLES only for kind advisor
prohibitions: No description read anywhere in resolution/guard/dispatch
No change to cell_role_list or non-advisor kinds

trace.outcome: Seat roles resolve per-seat models; unconfigured seats fall through to the advisor at the advisor door only; doctor advises on undescribed hat slots
deviations: requested_role rides economics rather than the tool payload — economics is inserted into BOTH the returned envelope and the appended dispatch-log row, while the payload is the literal Agent/Bash/spawn_agent argument map and an unknown key there would be handed to the tool — found a better route

Added packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/doctor/tests.rs (reserved before writing) — doctor.rs declares mod tests; against that separate file, so the advisory has nowhere else to be tested — hit an unforeseen obstacle

The helper is named role_slot_resolves rather than a seat-only name — it asks a question about any role slot and nothing in it is seat-specific, so a seat-shaped name would have been a lie about its scope — found a better route
Doctor names undescribed hats in the CONFIG's own order, not sorted; my first test expectation assumed alphabetical and went red — the plan was wrong about a fact
